name: piano-buddy
description: Piano Buddy: Website (apps/website), App unter /app (apps/app, auch iOS), geteilte Logik (packages/core) und Bausteine (packages/ui).

scripts.test: pnpm -r test && vp test run convex
scripts.deploy: convex deploy -y --cmd 'pnpm build' --cmd-url-env-var-name VITE_CONVEX_URL && pnpm --filter @piano/app deploy:worker && pnpm --filter @piano/website deploy:worker && pnpm --filter @piano/mailer deploy:worker
